critical_steps: For one scalar block with weight two, the relay frame operator is four times the identity and the canonical dual analysis map is one quarter of the identity.
The source reconstruction constraint forces g=1/4 at f=1.
The printed two sides are 1/16 and 13/16 respectively.
The source proof establishes weighted orthogonality of g-a(f) and a(f), which gives the corrected weighted Pythagorean identity.
Changing variables h_ij=v_ij g_ij converts the correction to the standard minimum-norm synthesis geometry.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact one-block scalar counterexample plus a direct weighted-Hilbert-space Pythagorean argument.
integrity.unproved_limits: No classification of all weight patterns or coefficient vectors for which the incorrect printed equality happens to hold is asserted.

scientific_limitations: The finding corrects Theorem 3.14 and does not reassess unrelated duality or stability results.
The repaired statement minimizes the weighted coefficient norm naturally induced by the relay weights.
For multi-block systems, the printed identity may hold accidentally for special data; no classification of those accidental cases is claimed.
title: The relay-fusion minimal-coefficient identity uses the wrong weight geometry
